messages:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — starting Odyssey17b (int4) canary on dedicated pool, hitting coldstart OOMs on 8k prompts with default max_new_tokens=1024.
Mike: seen the same on a couple of nodes, reproducible on cuda-05 and cuda-07. logs show mem spike during kernel init. :thinking_face: 
Priya: any sign it's KV prefetch or batching window? those usually trigger frag at coldstart.
Ashley: initial dump suggests kernel scratch allocation + kv warmup consuming extra transient memory. stack: 
```
[2024-07-12 21:08:04] alloc_scratch(614400000) -> success
[2024-07-12 21:08:04] kv_prefetch(450MB) -> started
[2024-07-12 21:08:05] OOM at allocate(200MB)
```
Mike: that aligns with spike when both prefetch and continuous batching kick in. we had similar with Nebula but different thresholds.
InfraBot: canary deploy v2 queued on pool-neo-3. will notify on status. :robot_face: 
Eva: model-level eval shows slight quality drop vs fp16 baseline on summarization set (ROUGE-L -1.8 pts on avg). could be quantization artifact or generation truncation.
Priya: is the quality drop correlated with lower max_new_tokens or with int4 noise? how are we decoding (top-p/temp)?
Ashley: same decoding params. suspicion: int4 KV rounding + early eviction when mem pressure spikes -> silent context loss for long summaries. logs show frequent KV evictions around 700 tokens.
Mike: hypotheses to test: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens to 512 for Odyssey, 2) disable aggressive prefetch on coldstart, 3) enable small warmup allocation (slot compaction) before heavy prefetch.
Priya: I can run an eval sweep: int4 w/ max_new_tokens {512,768,1024} and prefetch {on,off} and measure ROUGE + token-level continuity metric. give me a stable job config.
Ashley: config snippet I'll use for canary (we'll toggle flags):
```yaml
model: odyssey-17b-int4
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  slot_reserve: 64
runtime:
  kv_prefetch: true # flip in canary
  prefetch_warmup: 0.2 # fraction of sequence to allocate early
  max_new_tokens_default: 1024
```
Mike: for the canary, set prefetch_warmup -> 0.6 and max_new_tokens_default -> 512. also add kernel_sched_hint: spread to reduce simultaneous scratch allocs.
Ashley: done. patch queued. infrabot says canary on two nodes now.
InfraBot: canary v2 started on cuda-05,cuda-07. logs will stream to #build-failures.
Priya: running eval (n=500 prompts) now. ETA ~ 18m. I'll push results to the eval dashboard and paste quick summary.
Eva: also run embedding similarity check across generations to detect silent context truncation: cosine sim of first 512 token embedding vs last 512 should be stable.
Mike: if we still see frag/ooms, fallback plan is to ship int8 quant variant for Odyssey and mark int4 as experimental with stricter defaults. that keeps perf for most while avoiding customer-facing OOMs.
Priya: quick interim results: with canary config (warmup 0.6, max_new=512, prefetch on) OOMs -> 0/100 that hit coldstart, avg latency +8% but stable. quality: ROUGE-L delta = -0.6 vs fp16 (much better). embedding sim drop reduced from 0.14 to 0.05.
Ashley: nice. that suggests fragmentation/eviction is main cause. favorite change: reduce default max_new_tokens to 512 for Odyssey and enable prefetch_warmup=0.6.
Eva: note a small remaining failure mode: bursty concurrent requests still cause slot contention. recommend adding per-VM small slot_reserve bump (64->128) for canary pool.
Mike: I'll update autoscaler policy to cap concurrent burst to 6 for this pool and add a small cooldown.
ML-Ops: scheduled a maintenance window now to roll that policy cluster-wide for odyssey pool at 03:00 UTC if canary stays green.
Ashley: action items: Priya finish full eval (n=2k) and open a PR with model_defaults: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch_warmup=0.6, slot_reserve=128. Mike update autoscaler. Eva run follow-up embedding regressions. I'll monitor canary till 02:30 UTC.
Priya: ack — will post final eval table in 25m.
Mike: ack — updating autoscaler in parallel.
Ashley: thanks all. good to see a mitigations path instead of reverting model. :thumbsup:
